name: Custom 3D Avatar
description: Import custom rigged .glb 3D avatars (Half-Life 2, World of Warcraft, Mixamo, VRM) and drive them live with Biketerra's pedaling & steering animations.

settings.label: Avatar replacement
settings.description: active = replace your rider with the selected .glb avatar; off = keep default Biketerra rider.

settings.label: Animation retargeting
settings.description: retarget_ik = live Biketerra spine/head pose + 2-bone IK locking feet to pedals and hands to bars; rigid_rider = attach whole model rigidly to rider.

settings.label: Scale multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier applied on top of automatic height normalization (e.g. 0.9 to 1.2).

settings.label: Vertical seat offset (m)
settings.description: Fine-tune avatar vertical position on the saddle in meters (+ up, - down).

settings.label: Fore/aft seat offset (m)
settings.description: Fine-tune avatar fore/aft position on the saddle in meters (- forward, + back).

settings.label: Facing direction override
settings.description: auto detects facing from left/right bones; override in degrees if an imported model faces sideways or backward.

settings.label: Cast ground shadow
settings.description: Project an animated ground shadow of the custom avatar onto the road.

settings.label: Hide default Biketerra rider
settings.description: Uncheck temporarily to overlap the custom avatar with Biketerra's native rider for scale/alignment tuning.
